<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_WorkAccident"
                  targetNamespace="https://example.org/bpmn/work-accident">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_WorkAccident">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_ReportingParties" name="Accident reporting parties" processRef="Process_WorkAccident"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Employer" name="Employer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_LabourInspectorate" name="Labour Inspectorate"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_AccidentInsurance" name="Accident insurance provider"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Directorate" name="Competent directorate"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_PrivateInsurer" name="Private insurance provider"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_EmployeeToEmployer" name="Immediate incident information" sourceRef="Task_NotifyEmployer" targetRef="Participant_Employer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_EmployerToInspectorate" name="Fatal or serious work accident report" sourceRef="Task_ReportInspectorate" targetRef="Participant_LabourInspectorate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_EmployerToAccidentInsurance" name="Qualifying work accident report" sourceRef="Task_ReportAccidentInsurance" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurance"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SelfEmployedToAccidentInsurance" name="Self-employed person's accident report" sourceRef="Task_SelfEmployedReport" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurance"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_StudentToDirectorate" name="Student or schoolchild accident report" sourceRef="Task_ReportDirectorate" targetRef="Participant_Directorate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SchoolToAccidentInsurance" name="School or educational institution accident report" sourceRef="Task_SchoolReport" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurance"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PrivateImmediate" name="Immediate written accident report" sourceRef="Task_PrivateImmediateReport" targetRef="Participant_PrivateInsurer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PrivateFatality" name="Fatality report within three days" sourceRef="Task_PrivateFatalityReport" targetRef="Participant_PrivateInsurer"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_WorkAccident" name="Work Accident" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Incident" name="Accident or safety event identified"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherInformation" name="Gather accident information">
      <bpmn:documentation>Gather information about the accident or near accident, the people involved, the circumstances, and any discovered serious and immediate safety or health risk or defect in protection systems.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssessContext" name="Assess accident context and reporting duties">
      <bpmn:documentation>Consider whether the event relates to insured gainful employment, including an accident at a location, time and with a cause correlated to the employment; working from home; the direct route between residence and work, lunch or home, including carpools; qualifying professional training and the route to or from it; a doctor visit on a route from home, work or training and back where the visit was notified to the employer in advance; a route to or from work or training to take a child to or collect them from childcare, daycare, external care or school where the person has supervisory responsibility; or use of advocacy groups or professional associations. For kindergarten children, schoolchildren and students, consider a connection to the insured kindergarten, school or university education, participation in a school or school-related event, the direct route between residence or permanent accommodation and kindergarten or school and home, a practical task prescribed by the curriculum or study regulations, or certain professional training orientations. In agricultural or forestry establishments, also consider covered work that is not performed directly in the insured employment: work in the owner's or employee's household where it serves the company to a considerable extent; work connected with guest accommodation; secondary occupations selling farm products; work erecting, converting or repairing buildings serving the establishment; and neighbourhood assistance for another agricultural or forestry establishment. Also consider accidents treated as equivalent to work accidents outside professional activity, including activities using services under the Unemployment Insurance Act or Labor Market Promotion Act (such as travel to an arranged job interview), assisting with an accident, donating blood, and training, exercises or service as a member of a listed aid organisation: volunteer fire brigade, volunteer water rescue service, volunteer rescue organisations, Austrian Red Cross, Austrian Alpine Rescue Service, Austrian Water Rescue, Austrian Rescue Dog Brigade, avalanche warning committees, air rescue service, or radiation detection and survey crews. Identify which reporting duties apply to the event and the people or organisations involved.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ApplicableReports" name="Select applicable reporting duties"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyEmployer" name="Notify employer immediately">
      <bpmn:documentation>Employees must immediately inform the employer of any work accident, incident that would almost have led to an accident, serious and immediate risk to safety and health discovered, or defect discovered in protection systems.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportInspectorate" name="Report fatal or serious accident to Labour Inspectorate">
      <bpmn:documentation>The employer must immediately report a work accident leading to a fatality or serious injury to the Labour Inspectorate if it has not been reported to the emergency services.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportAccidentInsurance" name="Report qualifying accident to accident insurance provider">
      <bpmn:documentation>Independently of other reporting, report within five days every work accident in which a person with accident insurance has been killed or injured so that they are unable to work for three days, in full or in part.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SelfEmployedReport" name="Self-employed person reports accident">
      <bpmn:documentation>A self-employed person must report to the accident insurance provider in good time accidents involving people they employ and accidents involving themselves.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportDirectorate" name="Student or schoolchild reports accident to directorate">
      <bpmn:documentation>Students and schoolchildren should report accidents to the competent directorate.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SchoolReport" name="School or educational institution reports accident">
      <bpmn:documentation>Schools, educational facilities and universities must report to the responsible accident insurance provider in triplicate, within a maximum of five days, every work accident through which a person with accident insurance is physically injured or killed.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PrivateImmediateReport" name="Report private-insurance accident in writing immediately">
      <bpmn:documentation>In the case of private insurance, the insured party must report an accident in writing immediately in line with the policy conditions, to avoid release of the provider from the obligation to perform.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PrivateFatalityReport" name="Report private-insurance fatality within three days">
      <bpmn:documentation>If there are fatalities, the insured party must report this within three days, even if the accident has already been reported.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_EmployeeNotified" name="Employer notified"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_InspectorateReported" name="Labour Inspectorate notified"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_AccidentInsuranceReported" name="Accident insurance provider notified"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_SelfEmployedReported" name="Self-employed accident reported"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_DirectorateReported" name="Directorate notified"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_SchoolReported" name="School accident reported"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_PrivateReported" name="Private insurer notified"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_PrivateFatalityReported" name="Private-insurance fatality reported"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Gather" sourceRef="StartEvent_Incident" targetRef="Task_GatherInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Gather_Assess" sourceRef="Task_GatherInformation" targetRef="Task_AssessContext"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assess_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_AssessContext" targetRef="Gateway_ApplicableReports"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Gateway_NotifyEmployer" sourceRef="Gateway_ApplicableReports" targetRef="Task_NotifyEmployer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">employee incident, near accident, serious immediate risk, or protection-system defect</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Gateway_Inspectorate" sourceRef="Gateway_ApplicableReports" targetRef="Task_ReportInspectorate">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">employer duty applies and work accident caused fatality or serious injury and emergency services have not reported it</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Gateway_AccidentInsurance" sourceRef="Gateway_ApplicableReports" targetRef="Task_ReportAccidentInsurance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">insured person was killed or injured and unable to work for at least three days, in full or in part</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Gateway_SelfEmployed" sourceRef="Gateway_ApplicableReports" targetRef="Task_SelfEmployedReport">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">self-employed person is involved and the accident involves that person or someone they employ</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Gateway_Directorate" sourceRef="Gateway_ApplicableReports" targetRef="Task_ReportDirectorate">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">student or schoolchild accident is to be reported to the competent directorate</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Gateway_School" sourceRef="Gateway_ApplicableReports" targetRef="Task_SchoolReport">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">school, educational facility or university duty applies and an insured person was physically injured or killed</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Gateway_PrivateImmediate" sourceRef="Gateway_ApplicableReports" targetRef="Task_PrivateImmediateReport">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">private insurance applies to the insured party and accident</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Gateway_PrivateFatality" sourceRef="Gateway_ApplicableReports" targetRef="Task_PrivateFatalityReport">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">private insurance applies and the accident involves a fatality</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotifyEmployer_End" sourceRef="Task_NotifyEmployer" targetRef="EndEvent_EmployeeNotified"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inspectorate_End" sourceRef="Task_ReportInspectorate" targetRef="EndEvent_InspectorateReported"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AccidentInsurance_End" sourceRef="Task_ReportAccidentInsurance" targetRef="EndEvent_AccidentInsuranceReported"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelfEmployed_End" sourceRef="Task_SelfEmployedReport" targetRef="EndEvent_SelfEmployedReported"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Directorate_End" sourceRef="Task_ReportDirectorate" targetRef="EndEvent_DirectorateReported"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_School_End" sourceRef="Task_SchoolReport" targetRef="EndEvent_SchoolReported"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateImmediate_End" sourceRef="Task_PrivateImmediateReport" targetRef="EndEvent_PrivateReported"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateFatality_End" sourceRef="Task_PrivateFatalityReport" targetRef="EndEvent_PrivateFatalityReported"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
